# Catalog

* [Body measurement targets by age](body-measurement-targets-by-age.md) - Target body measurements (height, chest, waist, hip, neck, cross-shoulder, back length) for girl/woman bodies at about 8, 13, 18 and 30 years, derived from vendor charts, and the leotard size each falls into.
* [GK Elite and Nike leotard size chart](gk-and-nike-size-chart.md) - GK Elite's girls'/women's leotard chart CXXS to A4XL (chest, waist, hip, torso in inches) and the metric version with heights from Nike's identical gymnastics chart; the reference size system for the app.
* [Other brands' leotard size systems](other-brand-size-systems.md) - Size labels and the few published measurements for Sylvia P, Quatro (sized by chest inches), Snowflake, Destira and others, compared with GK; which charts were not captured.

# Domain Concept

* [How a leotard sits on the body](how-a-leotard-sits-on-the-body.md) - Where a competition leotard's leg line, neckline, armholes, seams and edges sit on the body, which limits are rules and which are inferred typical placements, and how taut fabric visibly behaves (bridging concavities, compression, edge grooves).
* [Stretch and negative ease](stretch-and-negative-ease.md) - Leotards are cut smaller than the body: about 90% of body girth for 80/20 nylon-spandex (10% pattern reduction), with finished swim and athletic suits at 20-30% negative ease; stretch is measured per direction and differs by fabric family.
* [Torso loop measurement](torso-loop-measurement.md) - The torso (girth) loop, from mid-shoulder down the front, through the crotch and up the back to the same shoulder, is the controlling leotard size measurement; how to measure it and how to check it on a 3D body.
* [Torso variants, measuring rules and sizing sets](torso-variants-and-sizing-sets.md) - Long- and short-torso variants (about 3 inches either side), brand measuring rules, fabric-specific sizing sets (plain nylon/spandex vs foil/mystique), fit kits and sizers, second-skin fit standard and per-order fit options such as shelf bras.
